events.text: my burgers came super late and the app lied about it being delivered
I'm sorry about that. I'll look into it. First I need to verify your identity. Please give me the full name on your account and either the email address or the phone number on it.
Leo Brandt. The phone number on the account is 415-555-0232.

events.note: Courier app marked delivered 2.1 miles from the address

events.text:
I've added $5.60 in account credit to your account. You can use it on a future order. I'm sorry the order was so late and that the app wrongly showed it as delivered.

Late deliveries are compensated with account credit only, so I can't refund the delivery fee or the order to your card. If any items were missing or wrong, tell me and I'll look into that too.

Okay, thanks for the apology. But I didn't get the order until about 7:45, and the app said it was delivered around 7pm. I was sitting at home waiting the whole time. Five dollars in credit doesn't really cover that, especially since I'm paying for a delivery that was late and wrong on the app.

I'd like a proper refund of the delivery fee at least, back to my card. The order number is 7201.

I understand why you're frustrated. You waited at home for 45 minutes after the app said your food had arrived. I'm sorry about that.

I can't refund the delivery fee to your card, though. Our policy compensates late deliveries with account credit only, and it sets the amount. For an order this late, that's 20% of the subtotal, which came to $5.60. I can't add goodwill refunds or extra credit beyond that.

The $5.60 credit is already on your account and will apply to your next order. If you'd like to talk to a person about this, I can pass your case to a human specialist. They'll follow up within 24 hours. Would you like me to do that?

Yeah, go ahead and pass it to a specialist. I'd rather someone with authority look at it than keep going around in circles with credit I can't even use until I order again. Just make sure the note says the app showed it delivered around 7pm and the courier didn't knock until 7:45.

args.summary: Customer Leo Brandt (verified) asked for a person after a late order Q-7201 (Burger Barn). Courier app marked delivered at 6:58 PM, 2.1 miles from the address. Courier arrived 7:45 PM and handed off in person at 7:47 PM, 47 minutes after the 7:00 PM promise. Customer says the app showed delivered around 7pm and the courier didn't knock until 7:45, and he waited at home the whole time. We issued $5.60 late-delivery credit (20% of $28 subtotal). Customer wants a card refund of the delivery fee ($3.49), which policy doesn't allow, and feels the credit is insufficient.

events.text:
I've passed your case to a human specialist, and they'll follow up within 24 hours. I can't promise what they'll decide.

The note says the app showed your order as delivered at about 7 PM and the courier didn't arrive until 7:45. It also says you were home waiting the whole time and that you're asking for a card refund of the delivery fee.

Your $5.60 credit stays on your account in the meantime.
Alright, thanks. Just so you know, I'm not happy that the app marked it delivered when nothing was here, and I'd like the specialist to actually look at it. I'll wait for their follow-up.
I understand, Leo. The specialist has the full details, including the false "delivered" status, and will look at your case. I'm sorry again for the wait and the confusion. Thanks for your patience.
